messages:
mike_sales: Polaris Systems sent back the SIG v2 and flagged Q25-Q28 as blockers for procurement. They asked for per-question artifacts + a 1-2 sentence plain-language answer. Need bundle by Tues EOD.

yasmin_se: I can grab Q25 (tenant isolation) and Q28 (network segmentation). Will need a redacted tenancy diagram and an Envoy snippet.

ollie_security: I'll take Q26 (KMS / key lifecycle) and Q27 (encryption at rest / in transit). I have a short rotation summary and an encryption practices note to attach.

tara_ps: I'll pull the SOC2 excerpt, the dataflow narrative, and a small POC screenshot showing tenant-level filters.

attachbot: File uploaded: <https://files.redwood.internal/tenancy_diagram_polaris.pdf|tenancy_diagram_polaris.pdf> (390KB)

yasmin_se: Polaris specifically asked for YAML for the proxy example. Drafting a sanitized snippet here (will redact before upload):
```yaml
# sanitized per-tenant routing sample
virtual_hosts:
  - name: tenant-polaris
    routes:
      - match: /tenant/polaris/*
        cluster: rwinf-tenant-polaris
```

yasmin_se: Also include a one-line note on cache namespaces.

ollie_security: For KMS, reference HSM-backed provider and automated rotation. I'll attach `kms_rotation_brief.md` and `encryption_practices.txt`. BYOK note: supported for Private deployments; will include the short line.

tara_ps: Uploaded SOC2 excerpt and dataflow narrative: <https://files.redwood.internal/soc2_polaris_excerpt.pdf|soc2_polaris_excerpt.pdf>, <https://files.redwood.internal/dataflow_polaris.md|dataflow_polaris.md>

attachbot: File uploaded: <https://files.redwood.internal/poc_tenant_filter_polaris.png|poc_tenant_filter_polaris.png> (98KB)

mike_sales: Please paste the final shared filenames and a 1-2 sentence plain-English blurb for each question so I can paste into their SIG answers. I'll run a final redaction pass and send to Polaris.

yasmin_se: Filenames: `/shared/sales-polaris/tenancy_diagram_redacted.pdf`, `/shared/sales-polaris/envoy_tenant_snippet.yaml`
yasmin_se: Plain English (Q25/Q28): "We route tenant traffic via tenant-specific proxy rules which map to isolated runtime clusters and distinct network segments; proxy and network policies prevent cross-tenant access."

ollie_security: Filenames: `/shared/sales-polaris/kms_rotation_brief.md`, `/shared/sales-polaris/encryption_practices.txt`, `/shared/sales-polaris/byok_note.txt`

ollie_security: Plain English (Q26/Q27): "Keys are stored in an HSM-backed KMS with scheduled rotations; data is encrypted in transit using TLS and at rest via disk-level encryption. Private deployments support BYOK through standard KMS APIs."

tara_ps: Filenames: `/shared/sales-polaris/soc2_excerpt.pdf`, `/shared/sales-polaris/dataflow_narrative.md`, `/shared/sales-polaris/poc_tenant_filter.png`

tara_ps: Plain English: "SOC2 controls and the dataflow doc explain access controls and how data moves through the system; the screenshot shows tenant filters in the runtime dashboard (no PII)."

mike_sales: Two quick asks before I compile: 1) ensure hostnames and account IDs are redacted in all artifacts, 2) add a one-line caption to the screenshot describing what's shown.

yasmin_se: Will redact hostnames/account IDs and add screenshot caption.

ollie_security: Added rotation cadence: "Rotation cadence: 90 days (automated); audit logs retained per policy."

tara_ps: Added caption: "Runtime dashboard filtered to tenant 'polaris-demo' showing request rate and errors (no customer data)."

mike_sales: Great — I'll package into `/shared/sales-polaris/polaris_sig_bundle.zip` and target sending to Polaris by Tue EOD. Ping me if anything changes. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
